prompt:
EDIT IMAGE 1 ONLY: game card 惩击 (Smite). KEEP ORIGINAL COMPOSITION, CAMERA AND ACTION. Landscape 4:3. Image1 is the composition/pose target; images2/3 are BROAD HAND-PAINTING STYLE references only, image4 is Xingyue IDENTITY only. Do not copy style reference people, hats or props. Do not import image4's standing pose, lantern or white background.

ORIGINAL SHOT INVARIANTS: Xingyue occupies LOWER RIGHT / center-right, same figure size and knee/waist crop, torso leaning diagonally as in the target. ONE arm extends all the way upward toward the UPPER-LEFT, arm crossing in front of torso beside her face; the bare hand POINTS upward with ONE index finger while other fingers naturally curl. Same elbow, wrist, finger position and silhouette. Her clear face remains just RIGHT of raised arm in mid/lower-right, looks toward viewer, both golden eyes readable. Long cream-gold hair flows to the RIGHT, her thick low braid curls to lower-left, same main paths. Deep teal shoulder cape flares behind/lower-left and large white priest dress fills lower-right. A thick GOLD-WHITE DIAGONAL judgment ray descends from UPPER-LEFT behind the raised hand/arm toward lower-center, same slant, position and width; keep its relationship to head and pointing finger. Huge quiet dark open region on RIGHT and LEFT around that ray. Do NOT center the person, change camera, change arm pose, add weapon or change beam direction.

CHARACTER IDENTITY: Xingyue normal priest form, adult woman, pale cream-gold long hair with thick straight blunt bangs, side braid feeding a LOW long thick plait, warm GOLD eyes, quiet composed focused expression and simple closed mouth. WHITE crescent hairpin clipped FLAT into hair immediately ABOVE BANGS, slightly off-center to VIEWER'S RIGHT, tilted and resting against hair (not floating, not halo). White C-shape with tips towards upper-right: correct target's yellow/brown clip into the established WHITE one, preserve its place. White priest dress with modest high neck, subdued gold collar/edges and small four-point star brooch, deep teal-green short cape with gold edges; dark cuff/wrist guard ends before bare pointing fingers. No lantern, staff, sword, floating moon, purple eyes or shadow-form outfit. Borrow identity from image4 without importing its more detailed rendering.

MAKE IT A ROUGH HAND-PAINTED ANIME COLOR STUDY, NOT A CLEAN CEL DRAWING OR POLISHED FANTASY RENDER. Large connected opaque masses, a few genuinely WIDE curved or elongated brush swipes and blunt dabs; one stroke explains a whole fold or hair lock. Coarse purposeful paint marks with handmade edges and broken ends, some sparse structural sketch lines and small imperfect overlaps. Quiet interior color areas dominate, selectively unfinished. Larger brush, fewer marks, far LESS detailed than image1.
Hair: 4–6 broad cream-gold masses, one muted gray-gold shadow turn and a couple irregular pale highlights; the braid in several large grouped segments, not individual hair strands. No spiky facet mosaic or fine shine streaks.
Face: clearly anime GOLD eyes with strong upper-lid strokes, one simple iris/pupil and one highlight each; a small nose mark, simple closed mouth, clean pale cheek mass and ONE broad under-jaw/fringe shadow. Readable attractive face with economical drawing, no airbrushed beauty shading, glossy lips or detailed iris ornament.
White sleeves/dress: 3–5 principal ivory/colored-gray light and shadow planes, a few broad directional fold strokes, not dense thin wrinkle outlines, elaborate gold cuff/star engraving or many tiny creases. Teal cape: quiet deep teal plane and 2–3 broad darker/lighter passes. Bare pointing hand anatomically clear with few marks, correct index finger connection.
Ray: ONE broad ivory/gold band with 2 sparse irregular parallel ivory edge marks, MATTE opaque painted light imagery, not a dense glow render. Light only a subtle broad warm touch near face/raised sleeve; no glossy bloom, tiny particles, spark showers, rune patterns or photoreal lighting.
BACKGROUND: alternating SOLID near-black navy/charcoal and muted gray-blue fields around the gold ray; keep original dark open areas. No smooth gradient cloud coating, scenic environment, sky, floor, buildings, terrain or new objects. Ray is an abstract symbolic judgment stroke only.
Muted white/gray/deep teal and pale cream-gold, gold eyes and gold-white judgment stripe are focal accents. Face and pointing hand receive selected clarity, cloth/hair/background remain coarse. Avoid all-over grain/canvas filters, tiny facets, thin line networks, glossy 3D, perfect vector outlines, overpainting every surface and decorative clutter. No text, card frame, logo, watermark or UI. Same original shot, decisively rougher hand-painted surface.
